title: Repair the remaining CORRECTION14 execution-transcript, repository-gate, audit-layout, classification, bundle-root, publication-boundary, Ruff-configuration, and test-inventory authority defects without rewriting F14 or S14 and without beginning Wave 1

known_correction14_authority_defects.hash_only_command_results: CommandResult discards raw stdout/stderr bytes, preventing OID and pathname derivation from the authoritative recorded result.
known_correction14_authority_defects.multiple_git_execution_paths: Commit resolution and range diff use multiple production helpers/subprocess paths rather than one transcript-producing seam.
known_correction14_authority_defects.gate_results_not_executed_by_driver: The production evidence driver can publish with an empty gate-results collection and gate identity is not a closed semantic type.
known_correction14_authority_defects.audit_layout_physical_paths_serialized: Serialized shard paths depend on temporary physical roots and macOS /private/var versus /var aliases; required/optional shard validation is also inconsistent.
known_correction14_authority_defects.constant_classification_claims: The renderer contains literal measured=True and constant zero proof values not derived from typed evidence.
known_correction14_authority_defects.incomplete_bundle_root: The root uses a declared subset rather than the complete final staging directory, omitting diagnostic .txt projections and not rejecting extras or non-regular entries.
known_correction14_authority_defects.premature_publication_claim: The staged immutable bundle claims publication before atomic rename and no separate post-rename manual publication transcript exists.
known_correction14_authority_defects.ruff_equivalence_unproven: The evidence records configuration identity but does not prove semantic equivalence to the canonical repository Ruff invocation for the exact subject path set.
known_correction14_authority_defects.test_inventory_unreconciled: The prior transcript describes a 63-test subset as the audit01 suite without node-ID reconciliation across S13/S14 and S15.

transaction_topology.F15: this plan-freeze commit; parent(F15) = S14; contains this plan and no other path
transaction_topology.S15: exactly one model-authored subject commit; parent(S15) = F15
transaction_topology.C: absent until a qualified Leamas v2 implementation produces it; never model-authored
transaction_topology.T: absent until Leamas v2 produces it; never model-authored
transaction_topology.E: absent until Leamas v2 produces protocol E; the manual evidence bundle and publication-result are not protocol E

executed_command_contract.type: @dataclass(frozen=True) class ExecutedCommand: name: str; argv: tuple[str, ...]; cwd: str; returncode: int; stdout: bytes; stderr: bytes; status: Literal['passed', 'failed', 'skipped']; stdout_sha256 and stderr_sha256 are properties derived from the raw bytes
executed_command_contract.serialized_form: Raw bytes remain authoritative in memory; JSON records their SHA-256 values and may reference separately persisted raw output files.
executed_command_contract.range_error: RangeResolutionError.stderr contains decoded command stderr, never its digest.

single_git_seam_contract.spy_proof: Patch subprocess.run and fail any invocation outside the injected Git command seam.

repository_gate_contract.type: @dataclass(frozen=True) class RepositoryGateResult: name: Literal[semantic names]; command: ExecutedCommand
repository_gate_contract.execution: The evidence driver executes every required gate before publication and passes the resulting typed records directly to bundle construction.

canonical_audit_path_contract.serialized_shard_identity: Each index shard path is its canonical logical file name (inventory.json, groups.json, helpers.json, core_usage.json, candidates.json, source_preservation.json, and gate_classification.json when present), independent of a physical root.
canonical_audit_path_contract.physical_resolution: ReportLayout resolves logical identities to physical paths only at read/write boundaries.

publication_contract.atomic_boundary: The rename from validated staging directory to fresh final destination is the publication event.

algorithm: reject descendants that are directories, symlinks, special files, or unexpected names
require the exact declared artifact set
hash every regular file except bundle-root.json
sort by canonical slash-separated relative path
write bundle-root.json without staging/output/temp absolute paths
independently re-enumerate and validate every recorded hash

ruff_configuration_contract.equivalence: Run the repository canonical Ruff command against the identical exact subject Python path tuple and prove both typed command results agree in return code and diagnostics semantics.
